title: Brand Ops Platform Pukang Raises ¥200M Series B from Jiecheng, Junwu, Youngor
summary: On Aug 26, 2022, brand lifecycle ops platform Pukang (璞康) closed a ¥200M Series B from Jiecheng Capital, Junwu Capital, and Youngor — for supply-chain, data mid-platform, team/brand; Jiecheng Group adds strategic resources. Founded 2004; offline distributor → digital brand-ops
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · September 6, 2022

On Aug 26, 2022, brand lifecycle ops platform Pukang (璞康) closed a ¥200M Series B from Jiecheng Capital, Junwu Capital, and Youngor — for supply-chain, data mid-platform, team/brand; Jiecheng Group adds strategic resources. Founded 2004; offline distributor → digital brand-ops group across appliances/3C, mother-baby, home, health, beauty, FMCG. 40–50+ intl brands (LEGO, Nestlé, Shiseido, Rinnai, AEG, B&O, WMF, Kao, Pigeon, Abbott…). 80,000㎡ warehouse / 500k+ orders/day / >99.5% accuracy; OMS-WMS-TMS linked. Content: 100k short videos + 40k designs/mo; 3,000+ creators / 10M+ fans. ’22 growth guided >50%. Target 100-brand matrix in 3 years.

— END —
